videos.title: Dating Expert: Why You Should Stop Chasing 'THE ONE' | Logan Ury
videos.description:
You don't need to find the right person. You need to stop looking for the spark.

In this clip, Logan Ury and Jay Shetty break down the three dating tendencies the romanticizer, the maximizer and the hesitator and why almost nobody can spot their own.

Logan argues that most people have the math backwards. They think finding love is 95% who you pick and 5% the effort you put in. Her research says it's closer to 25% and 75%. She also shares why 69% of Gen Z say they're not ready for a relationship they actually want, and the gap between what men think women need and what women say they want.

Learn about the Post-Date 8, the eight questions to ask yourself after every date, and why the question is never "did I find them attractive" but "did I feel attractive around them."

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.title: Running evals on your internal agents is how you keep them trustworthy over time
videos.description: Intercom logs every PR review their agent produces and has an engineer review whether the scoring was right. The same discipline you apply to customer-facing AI products, where you build evals to catch regressions, applies to internal bots that touch critical systems like your codebase.
